MARTA KOWAL-BRANDT
QA AUTOMATION ENGINEER | CI/CD & TEST INFRASTRUCTURE
Wroclaw, Poland | marta.kowalbrandt@example.com | +48 555 303 303 | gitlab.com/mkb-example

PROFESSIONAL SUMMARY
QA automation engineer with 7 years of experience, focused in recent years on CI/CD pipelines, test infrastructure and build tooling. Owns GitLab CI pipelines for three product teams and has built ephemeral test environments using Docker Compose and Helm on a shared Kubernetes cluster. Also develops personal infrastructure projects with k3s, GitOps, monitoring and Terraform. Targeting a move into DevOps or platform engineering.

SKILLS
CI/CD and containers: GitLab CI, Jenkins, Docker, Docker Compose, Helm
Infrastructure and cloud: Kubernetes (namespace-level access and test-environment deployments), k3s, Terraform (personal project), Argo CD, Ansible (basic), AWS (EC2 and S3 basics; personal learning)
Monitoring and data: Prometheus, Grafana, Loki, PostgreSQL, SQL
Scripting and systems: Python, Bash, Linux, Git
Testing: pytest, Playwright, Selenium, Postman, Java (test code)

SELECTED PROJECTS
Merge-Request Ephemeral Environments | Odrava Health Software | 2023-2024
- Built short-lived environments for each merge request, with the application, PostgreSQL and seeded data deployed via Helm to a shared Kubernetes cluster from GitLab CI.
- Configured automatic cleanup after merge or 48 hours of inactivity; QA and product teams use the environments for feature review and e2e testing.
- Technologies: GitLab CI, Helm, Kubernetes, Docker, Bash, PostgreSQL.

CI Pipeline Speed-up | Odrava Health Software | 2022
- Profiled pipelines for three teams, parallelised test jobs, added dependency caching and split e2e tests into a separate stage.
- Reduced average pipeline time from 38 to 14 minutes and monthly CI runner cost by approximately 30%.
- Technologies: GitLab CI, Docker, pytest-xdist.

Homelab k3s Cluster with GitOps | Personal | 2024-2025
- Built a three-node Raspberry Pi 5 k3s cluster, with applications deployed from a Git repository using Argo CD.
- Set up Prometheus, Grafana and Loki monitoring, Traefik ingress and cert-manager for TLS; provisioned infrastructure for a small Hetzner VPS with Terraform.
- Technologies: k3s, Argo CD, Prometheus, Grafana, Loki, Terraform, Ansible (basic).

Flaky Test Dashboard | Odrava Health Software | 2023
- Collected CI test results in PostgreSQL and created Grafana dashboards showing flaky tests by team.
- Flaky-test rate fell from 7% to below 1% after teams began addressing the most frequent offenders.
- Technologies: Python, PostgreSQL, Grafana, GitLab API.

EXPERIENCE
QA Automation Engineer (Test Infrastructure) | Odrava Health Software | Wroclaw | 2021-Present
- Owns GitLab CI pipelines for three product teams, approximately 25 developers, covering build, unit, integration and e2e test stages and artifact publishing.
- Maintains a pytest and Playwright e2e suite of approximately 900 tests; reduced the flaky-test rate from 7% to below 1%.
- Writes Python and Bash tooling for seeding test data into PostgreSQL.
- Wrote the internal guide to how CI works, used in onboarding, and mentored two QA interns in 2023.

QA Engineer | Brightmill Software House | Wroclaw | 2019-2021
- Tested web and mobile applications for client projects using manual and automated testing.
- Introduced a Java and Selenium automated regression suite for the largest client project and configured Jenkins jobs for nightly runs.

Customer Support Specialist (2nd line) | Brightmill Software House | 2018-2019
- Investigated customer issues in logs and databases and reproduced bugs for developers.

EDUCATION
BEng Computer Engineering | Silesian Lowlands University of Technology | 2018

CERTIFICATION AND PROFESSIONAL DEVELOPMENT
ISTQB Foundation Level | 2019
Preparing for the Certified Kubernetes Administrator (CKA) exam, scheduled for January 2027
docs.cover_letter:
Dear Corvale Mobility Hiring Team,

I am applying for the Cloud Infrastructure / DevOps Contractor – Fleet Connectivity role. My experience sits at the boundary of automation and infrastructure: I own GitLab CI pipelines for three product teams and have built short-lived Kubernetes environments that let teams validate changes before merge.

At Odrava Health Software, I built merge-request environments deployed with Helm to a shared Kubernetes cluster, with automatic cleanup and e2e tests against each environment. I also improved the pipelines used by three teams, reducing average run time from 38 to 14 minutes and monthly CI runner cost by approximately 30%. These projects have involved making build and test workflows repeatable and useful to developers, and documenting CI for onboarding.

I have also built a personal k3s homelab using Argo CD, Prometheus, Grafana and Loki, and provisioned infrastructure for a small Hetzner VPS with Terraform. My Terraform work and AWS exposure (EC2 and S3 basics) are currently personal learning projects; my production infrastructure work has focused on CI/CD and namespace-level Kubernetes test deployments. I am preparing for the CKA exam, scheduled for January 2027.

Corvale’s work on a new train fleet makes this a particularly interesting opportunity to apply my infrastructure and automation experience to systems connecting vehicles and cloud services. I would welcome the opportunity to discuss how my background could contribute to the team’s work on reliable, observable infrastructure.

Thank you for your consideration.

Marta Kowal-Brandt
